channel.title: Ben's Daily Digest
channel.description: A personalized daily headline digest across Ben's core interests, local NYC-metro news, and a rotating set of adjacent topics.

item.title: [NYC Metro] An ICE critic's email prompted a visit to the man's NY home. A judge says his rights were likely violated.
item.description: Plaintiff David Streever of Rochester. A federal judge ruled the government's threats against a critic likely violated First Amendment protections. [ more › ]

item.title: [NYC Metro] Sorry, NYC drivers. Traffic is about to get even worse than usual.
item.description: The city's designated 20 "gridlock days" through the end of 2026. The worst of them are upon us. [ more › ]

item.title: [Soccer] Mourinho and Simeone renew rivalry in Madrid derby after more than a decade
item.description: Jose Mourinho and Diego Simeone renew their rivalry after a 12-year wait as Real Madrid visit Atletico Madrid in Sunday's Spanish capital derby.

item.title: [NYC Metro] More than 80 chickens rescued from abandoned truck in Brooklyn, activists say
item.description: Photos shared by activists show that a sign reading "Kaparos on the Go" was affixed to the truck. Activists say the chickens are linked to a pre-Yom Kippur sacrifice custom practiced by a minority of ultra-Orthodox Jews. [ more › ]

item.title: [Tech & AI] Flock reportedly tries to shrink workforce with employee buyouts
item.description: Without buyouts, Flock would "almost certainly" need to lay off staff.

item.title: [Tech & AI] Trump says it’s time to rebrand AI with a new name — and he’s also creating an AI Force
item.description: Trump claimed, without evidence, that the AI backlash is a Democratic hoax.

item.title: [NYC Metro] 15-year-old girl dies after truck hits 2 teens in East Village
item.description: East 14th Street and 1st Avenue A 16-year-old was hospitalized and in stable condition, police said. [ more › ]

item.title: [Date Night / Things To Do] NYC Climate Week, the largest event of its kind globally, kicks off Sunday
item.description: An aerial view of Central Park from 2025. The 18th annual NYC Climate Week centers around concerns about AI, data centers, climate adaptation, energy and the grid. [ more › ]

item.title: [Soccer] Brighton cruise past Arsenal to end champions' perfect start
item.description: Brighton secure a 3-0 victory over Premier League champions Arsenal to inflict the Gunners' first defeat of the season.

item.title: [Personal Finance (broader)] Venture Capital Paper Gains Aren’t Real But Still Feel Great Anyway
item.description: Historically, I've viewed stocks as funny money. It's not real until it's converted into something you can use. Given the lack of utility for stocks, I've long preferred owning real estate. Being able to touch, see, and enjoy your investment without experiencing daily volatility…

item.title: [Quick Veg/Pescetarian Recipes] Vegan Nutella Ice Cream
item.description: Friends! The fluffiest, most satisfying, Nutella lover’s dream dessert is here: vegan ice cream made with chocolate and hazelnuts. It’s creamy, dreamy, oh-so delicious, and kind of perfect! Especially when craving a sweet treat on a warm summer day. Just 6 ingredients…
